purpose: Pre-registered closure/treatment policy for the C++ parallel-population candidate (ralplan Revision 4, ARCH-POP-GATE-007 / SUBMISSION-POP-006).

forbiddenPatterns.note: kernel_bandit.hpp ships as a library dependency of kernel_parallel_bandit.hpp; its scalar runtime surface (Engine::runKernelBandit / run_kernel_bandit binding) must NOT exist in the candidate. v5.5 seed-lock repair, event compact, assignment flow/cycles, Benders/MCTS/pattern/learned/backbone/large-ruin and every OGC_CPP_* runtime switch are prohibited.

allowedCanonicalEnvNote: OGC_PREFP remains only as canonical knobs.hpp text (unused by the candidate treatment; driver boost is engine-owned via set_pref_p). OGC_SLICE is the canonical-shipped ablation switch and keeps its v5.3 default-on semantics.

runtimeTreatment.baseBudgetDefinition: B = sec computed by canonical _arm_free after the gate-reserve subtraction (sec = max(2, deadline - now - reserve)) and before any carve
runtimeTreatment.eligibility: not _pop_here and B > 60.0; _pop_here (sec >= 150 and sec/n <= 1.6) keeps the unchanged Python population path with zero tail
callOrder: primary run_portfolio + canonical slice handling within 0.85*B
C++ parallel population tail from the engine-audited incumbent
runtimeTreatment.startingBoardAuthority: engine internally audited incumbent; no additional official-checker round trip before the tail; final authority stays with canonical _gate
runtimeTreatment.deadlineGuard: tail runs only if now + 1.0 < deadline - reserve and is clamped to min(_pop_tail, deadline - reserve - now)

reviewerSchema.rule: every added/modified hunk must be signed required with a requiredBy trace, or excluded as unrelated-reject; any unclear separation fails candidate preparation
